name_th: บลิทซ์ไปก์

fields.name: skillRate[0]
fields.when: SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ls 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: skillRate[1]
fields.when: SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: fixAddDamage[0]
fields.when: fixAddDamage.Length ls 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) lt 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: fixAddDamage[1]
fields.when: SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) lt 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ls 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: abnormalPer
fields.when: SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) lt 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) ge 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: skillRate[1]
fields.when: fixAddDamage.Length eq 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR fixAddDamage.Length ls 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR SkillManager.GetSkillLv(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillManager(), SkillId.ThorHammer, 1) lt 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: skillRate[0]
fields.when: skillRate.Length eq 1 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR fixAddDamage.Length eq 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1 OR fixAddDamage.Length ls 1 AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 1

fields.name: SkillIndividualFlag
fields.when: (MobActionManagerBase.get_PlayerMeterDistance(UnityEngine.GameObject.GetComponent<MobActionManagerBase>(target)) lt 8 ? 1 : 0) eq 1 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(target) OR (MobActionManagerBase.get_PlayerMeterDistance(UnityEngine.GameObject.GetComponent<MobActionManagerBase>(target)) lt 8 ? 1 : 0) ne 1 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(target)

fields.name: mainTarget
fields.when: (MobActionManagerBase.get_PlayerMeterDistance(UnityEngine.GameObject.GetComponent<MobActionManagerBase>(target)) lt 8 ? 1 : 0) eq 1 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(target) OR (MobActionManagerBase.get_PlayerMeterDistance(UnityEngine.GameObject.GetComponent<MobActionManagerBase>(target)) lt 8 ? 1 : 0) ne 1 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(target)

terms.name: AddRate[SkillRate]
terms.when: fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR fixAddDamage.Length eq 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0

terms.name: AddConstant[SkillConstantDamage]
terms.when: fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR !PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0

terms.name: SetRate[ExpRate]
terms.when: fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR !PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0

terms.name: AddRate[SkillRate]
terms.when: fixAddDamage.Length hi 1 AND skillRate.Length hi 1 OR fixAddDamage.Length ls 1 AND skillRate.Length hi 1

effects.name: SkillBufferManager.AddSelfBuffer
effects.when: attackCount eq 2 OR attackCount eq 0 AND attackCount ne 2 OR attackCount ne 0 AND attackCount ne 2

effects.name: SkillBufferManager.RemoveSelfBuffer
effects.when: attackCount eq 2 OR attackCount eq 0 AND attackCount ne 2 OR attackCount ne 0 AND attackCount ne 2

effects.name: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent
effects.when: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0 OR !PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0

effects.name: SkillDamageData.SetAbnormalType
effects.when: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Paralysis, abnormalPer, playerAction) AND fixAddDamage.Length ne 0 AND skillRate.Length ne 0

effects.name: BlitzPikeBuf..ctor
effects.when: UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(actarAction) AND param eq 101 OR TryGetBuf<object>.out2(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillBufferManager(), 980) ne 0 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(actarAction) AND param eq 101

effects.name: SkillBufferManager.AddSelfBuffer
effects.when: UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(actarAction) AND param eq 101 OR TryGetBuf<object>.out2(PlayerStatusBase.get_SkillBufferManager(), 980) ne 0 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(actarAction) AND param eq 101

intervalTimer.when: IsEnd eq 0 AND max((intervalTimer - UnityEngine.Time.get_deltaTime()), 0) hi 0 OR !UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(playerAction) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND max((intervalTimer - UnityEngine.Time.get_deltaTime()), 0) ls 0 OR !UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit(playerAction.battleManager) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND System.Linq.Enumerable.FirstOrDefault<BlitzPikeBuf.EffectData>(effectDataList, new System.Func<BlitzPikeBuf.EffectData, bool>) ne 0 AND UnityEngine.Object.op_Inequality(playerAction) AND max((intervalTimer - UnityEngine.Time.get_deltaTime()), 0) ls 0
